observations: Large white plastic IBC (Intermediate Bulk Container) tank.
Metal cage structure with vertical and horizontal bars.
A blue-handled spigot is visible on the front side.
A red and white label is attached to the side, but the text is illegible.
The tank appears to be empty and sitting on the ground.
Watermark 'BONIFACE OVI LINK' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' are visible on all photos.

claims.claim: To store industrial liquids or hazardous chemicals

claims.evidence: No label or stamp confirms this; it is a common marketing claim for such tanks.

claims.claim: used only once for clean water. No crack, no leak, lids complete.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The tank may be empty or contain a hazardous substance.
risks.proof: A photo of the tank with a water level mark or a label showing the contents.

risks.risk: The tank may be leaking or have structural damage.
risks.proof: A video showing the tank being filled and the spigot working.

risks.risk: The tank may be expired or have a low chemical resistance rating.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's stamp showing the production date and material specifications.

proof_requests: Photo of the manufacturer's stamp showing the capacity (e.g., 1000L) and material.
Photo of the label showing the contents or chemical resistance rating.
Video of the spigot being opened and water flowing out to confirm functionality.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
